detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Processing in Music and Information Persistence
detail.summary: This journal entry summarizes the systematic synthesis of research regarding the relationship between predictive processing mechanisms and information persistence. By analyzing existing sources, we establish provisional notebooks for ongoing projects in music cognition and information survival, focusing on how error-correction and predictive calibration function across these distinct domains.

detail.title: Predictive Processing in Music Appreciation
detail.summary: Explores how musical structures act as temporal sequences that engage the brain's predictive processing systems, modulating emotional valence via error signal calibration.
detail.reason: Synthesis of foundational predictive processing research relevant to the project's question.

detail.title: Duality of Information Persistence
detail.summary: Synthesizes the dual requirement for information persistence: physical entropy resistance through formal error correction and semantic relevance maintenance through active inference.
detail.reason: Provides a conceptual bridge between predictive processing mechanisms and long-term information survival.
